"Morning rules for the evening shift"
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to maintain careful, humane, and consistent handling of animal travel requests for Aurelia Skyways.

The desk is to receive each request in calm language, confirm the traveler record, and route any uncertain point to the senior coordinator without delay. Staff must keep their tone measured, avoid abrupt handling instructions, and remember that the animal's comfort and safety come before convenience. Where an animal is to travel in the cabin, the cabin team is to be informed so that monitoring is steady and respectful throughout the flight. When a crate is used, the desk is to review it for clean condition, secure closures, and adequate space, and the staff member is to note any concern before approval continues. <<FACT F059>> The review must remain factual and free of extra comment, because the record is meant to support orderly service and humane care. If a traveler such as Andre Nguyen, Khalil Costa, or Mia is listed in the file, the same standards apply without exception and without favoritism.

The desk is also to ensure that the animal is presented in a condition suitable for travel and that handlers use the least stressful method available. Staff are to speak plainly to travelers, avoid crowded handling areas where practical, and escalate any sign of distress to the senior coordinator at once. <<FACT F071>> No one is to improvise a workaround that weakens safety, and no one is to promise acceptance before the review is complete. A record is to be entered only after the required checks are finished, and any correction is to be made promptly and with accountability.

If the case cannot be resolved at desk level, contact the senior coordinator or the cabin team, as appropriate, for immediate guidance.
